name: 7 Days from Marrakech to Chefchaouen via the Sahara and Fes
seoTitle: 7 Days from Marrakech to Chefchaouen via the Sahara and Fes | Private Tour
seoDescription: Seven days from Marrakech to Chefchaouen: High Atlas, Ait Ben Haddou, a night in the Sahara at Merzouga, Fes and Volubilis. Private driver and local guides.
overview: Cross Morocco from the red city of Marrakech to the blue lanes of Chefchaouen. Over seven days you cross the High Atlas, spend a night in the Sahara at Merzouga, walk the medina of Fes and finish in the Rif Mountains. It is the south-to-north route in one unhurried journey, with a private driver and licensed local guides.
Every Atlas Private Tours journey is private and can be adjusted to your dates, pace and interests. Contact us to change this itinerary.
highlights: Cross the High Atlas by the Tizi n’Tichka pass
Guided visit to the kasbah of Ait Ben Haddou, a UNESCO World Heritage Site
Todra Gorges and the Dades Valley
Camel trek and a night in a desert camp at Erg Chebbi
Guided exploration of the Fes medina
Roman ruins of Volubilis
Wander the blue streets of Chefchaouen

itinerary.title: Marrakech / Ait Ben Haddou / Ouarzazate
itinerary.text: After meeting your driver in Marrakech, climb into the High Atlas over the Tizi n’Tichka pass. Visit the kasbah of Ait Ben Haddou with a local guide, then continue to Ouarzazate for the night.

itinerary.title: Ouarzazate / Dades Valley / Todra Gorges / Merzouga
itinerary.text: Drive east through the Dades Valley and the Todra Gorges, with stops for photographs and lunch. In the late afternoon reach the Sahara at Merzouga, ride a camel into the dunes at sunset and spend the night in a desert camp.

itinerary.title: Merzouga / Midelt / Fes
itinerary.text: Watch the sunrise over the Erg Chebbi dunes, then begin the long drive north through the Ziz Valley, Midelt and the cedar forests of the Middle Atlas to Fes.

itinerary.title: Fes
itinerary.text: A full day with a licensed guide in the old medina: Bab Boujloud, the Qarawiyyin quarter, the medersas, the tanneries and the souks.

itinerary.title: Fes / Meknes / Volubilis / Chefchaouen
itinerary.text: Leave Fes for the imperial city of Meknes, then visit the Roman ruins of Volubilis and continue north into the Rif Mountains to Chefchaouen.

itinerary.title: Chefchaouen
itinerary.text: A free day in the blue city. Walk the medina, climb to the Spanish Mosque viewpoint, or ask us to arrange a morning in the nearby mountains.

itinerary.title: Chefchaouen departure
itinerary.text: Breakfast, then your driver takes you to your onward destination or airport. Contact us beforehand if you would like a different ending point.

includes: Private air-conditioned transportation with a professional driver throughout the tour
Licensed local guides for the city visits
Accommodation in quality hotels, riads, and a desert camp in Merzouga (private tent)

itinerary.text: Meet your driver in Errachidia and drive south through the Ziz Valley and Erfoud to the dunes. Ride a camel at sunset and spend the night in a desert camp.

itinerary.title: Merzouga / Rissani / Todra Gorges / Dades
itinerary.text: Sunrise over the dunes, then Rissani and the Todra Gorges before reaching the Dades Valley for the night.

itinerary.title: Dades / Skoura / Ouarzazate
itinerary.text: Follow the Valley of the Roses and the palm groves of Skoura to Ouarzazate for the night.

itinerary.title: Ouarzazate / Ait Ben Haddou / Marrakech
itinerary.text: Visit the kasbah of Ait Ben Haddou with a local guide, then cross the High Atlas by the Tizi n’Tichka pass to Marrakech. Your driver takes you to your hotel, the airport or the station.

name: 5 Days from Errachidia to Marrakech via the Sahara and Fes
seoTitle: 5 Days from Errachidia to Marrakech via the Sahara and Fes | Private Tour
seoDescription: Five days from Errachidia to Marrakech: the Sahara at Merzouga, the Fes medina and the Ouzoud Waterfalls. A private journey you can adjust.
overview: Five days that link the desert, the imperial city of Fes and Marrakech. You spend a night in the Sahara at Merzouga, cross the Middle Atlas to Fes for a guided day in the medina, then travel south by the Ouzoud Waterfalls to Marrakech.
Every Atlas Private Tours journey is private and can be adjusted to your dates, pace and interests. Contact us to change this itinerary.
highlights: Camel trek and a night in a desert camp
Ziz Valley, Midelt and Ifrane
Guided visit to the Fes medina
Ouzoud Waterfalls

itinerary.title: Errachidia / Erfoud / Merzouga
itinerary.text: Meet your driver in Errachidia and drive south to the dunes of Merzouga. Ride a camel at sunset and spend the night in a desert camp.

itinerary.title: Merzouga / Midelt / Ifrane / Fes
itinerary.text: Sunrise over the dunes, then the long drive north through Midelt and the Middle Atlas, past Ifrane, to Fes.

itinerary.title: Fes
itinerary.text: A full day with a licensed guide in the old medina: Bab Boujloud, the medersas, the tanneries and the souks.

itinerary.title: Fes / Azrou / Beni Mellal / Ouzoud / Marrakech
itinerary.text: Leave Fes through the Middle Atlas and Azrou, stop at the Ouzoud Waterfalls and continue to Marrakech.

itinerary.title: Marrakech
itinerary.text: A free day in Marrakech, with an optional guided visit to the medina. Transfer to the airport or station when you are ready.
